name: 黑虚闪
description: 灵压。对6格内1名敌人造成200%攻击力的魔法伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 6, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var result = dealDamage(caster, target, caster.attack * 2, 'magical', battle, 'ulquiorra-black-cero'); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '释放黑虚闪，造成' + (result.damage || 0) + '点魔法伤害' }; }
